instruction: Design a module that combines a 4-to-1 multiplexer with a 2-to-1 multiplexer to create a 8-to-1 multiplexer. The module should have three input ports for selecting the input data, and four input ports for each of the eight input data. The module should output four bits of the selected input data. The module should not use any built-in Verilog multiplexer components.
